message.content:
**Signatories of the U.S. Declaration of Independence**

| Signer | State / Colony Represented |
|--------|----------------------------|
| **John Adams** | Massachusetts |
| **Samuel Adams** | Massachusetts |
| **Robert Treat Paine** | Connecticut |
| **William Ellery** | Rhode Island |
| **Stephen Hopkins** | Rhode Island |
| **Roger Sherman** | New York |
| **Francis Lewis** | New York |
| **Philip Livingston** | New York |
| **Lewis Morris** | New Jersey |
| **Richard Stockton** | New Jersey |
| **David Brearley** | New Jersey |
| **Thomas McKean** | Pennsylvania |
| **George Clymer** | Pennsylvania |
| **James Smith** | Delaware |
| **Benjamin Rush** | Pennsylvania |
| **Joseph Hewes** | North Carolina |
| **Edward Rutledge** | South Carolina |
| **Charles Pinckney** | South Carolina |
| **Henry Laurens** | South Carolina |
| **Moses Fleetwood Walker** | Virginia |
| **George Wythe** | Virginia |
| **Patrick Henry** | Virginia |
| **George Mason** | Virginia |
| **John Witherspoon** | New Jersey |
| **Benedict Arnold** | New Hampshire |
| **Ethan Allen** | Vermont (then part of NY) |
| **John Jay** | New York |
| **John Dickinson** | Maryland |
| **Josiah Bartlett** | New Hampshire |
| **Matthew Thornton** | Maine (then part of NH) |
| **Elijah Hise** | Georgia |
| **Lyman Hall** | Georgia |
| **Cyrus Griffin** | Georgia |
| **John Hancock** | Massachusetts (his signature famously bold) |
| **Thomas Jefferson** | Virginia (author of the draft) |
| **Benjamin Franklin** | Pennsylvania |
| **Alexander Hamilton** | New York |

> *Total:* **56 delegates** from the thirteen colonies affixed their signatures on August 2, 1776 at the Second Continental Congress in Philadelphia.

### Quick Highlights
* **John Hancock’s** signature became emblematic because it was larger than most others—hence “Hancock” entered common usage as slang for an autograph.
* **Thomas Jefferson**, though he drafted the document, did not sign until later; his signature appears among those who were present when the vote passed.
* **Benjamin Franklin**’s penmanship made his signature appear almost illegible—a fun fact often cited in trivia quizzes.

If you’d like deeper biographical sketches of individual signers or information on how the signing ceremony unfolded, just let me know!
